title: Metals, Non-metals & Metalloids
notes:
Metals, Non-Metals & Metalloids

  • Metals: Electropositive, lose electrons, malleable, ductile, conduct heat & electricity. (Hg is liquid).
  • Non-metals: Electronegative, gain electrons, bad conductors (except graphite/graphene). Exist in solid (C, S, I₂), liquid (Br₂), and gas (O₂, N₂).
  • Metalloids: Dual properties, semiconductors (Si, Ge, As, Sb).
